textures.name: MESSENGER / Mariner 10 monochrome mosaic (2009)
textures.credit: NASA/Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory/Carnegie Institution of Washington/U. S. Geological Survey/Arizona State University
textures.note: Historical photometric mosaic covers 97.7% of Mercury; source gaps and mosaic seams retained. Not a natural-color image. Longitude registration is illustrative.
textures.processing: Exact source JPEG, no pixel edits.
textures.license: Credited NASA/JPL scientific imagery; media-use policies apply; third-party credits retained.

textures.name: Mars Viking texture map
textures.note: Historical Viking mosaic, processed at USGS. JPL cautions that simulator maps are illustrative and must not be used for scientific image analysis.
textures.processing: Exact source JPEG, no pixel edits.
textures.license: Credited NASA/JPL scientific imagery; media-use policies apply; third-party credits retained.

textures.name: Jupiter Hubble global map (2019)
textures.credit: NASA, ESA, A. Simon (Goddard Space Flight Center), and M. H. Wong (University of California, Berkeley)
textures.note: Historical 2019 cloud mosaic. Unobserved regions above 80 degrees latitude remain black. Cloud features and longitude registration are illustrative, not a prediction of current weather.
textures.processing: TIFF to RGB JPEG quality90; source dimensions and no-data regions retained.
textures.license: Credited NASA/JPL scientific imagery; media-use policies apply; third-party credits retained.

textures.name: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit 2025 color map
textures.credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio / Ernie Wright; LROC data, Arizona State University
textures.note: NASA visualization map from LRO: exposure and white balance adjusted; polar color gaps filled from lower-resolution laser albedo and small dropouts inpainted by the producer. Optimized for illustration, not scientific image analysis. Center longitude0 degrees.
textures.processing: Exact NASA source JPEG; no further pixel edits.

purpose: Historical appearance maps only; ephemeris coordinates and physical radii are separate from illustrative surface appearance.
